dish_name: Sichuan spicy fish with glass noodles and potatoes
components: Sichuan spicy fish with glass noodles and potatoes
source: generic recipe written by claude-opus-5-5 from the dish name only; not taken from any recording

steps.component: Sichuan spicy fish with glass noodles and potatoes
steps.text: Fetch the fish, chicken, eggs, spring onions and cilantro from the fridge
steps.checkpoint: fridge items are on the counter

steps.component: Sichuan spicy fish with glass noodles and potatoes
steps.text: Fetch the glass noodles, potatoes, doubanjiang, dried chilies, Sichuan peppercorns, garlic, ginger, stock, wine, cornstarch, oil and seasoning from the pantry
steps.checkpoint: pantry items are on the counter

steps.component: oven-baked chicken nuggets
steps.text: Fetch the flour, breadcrumbs, paprika and garlic powder
steps.checkpoint: breading ingredients are on the counter

steps.component: Sichuan spicy fish with glass noodles and potatoes
steps.text: Get out the wok, pot, cutting board, knife, bowls, peeler, serving bowl, small pan, baking tray and shallow plates

steps.component: oven-baked chicken nuggets
steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220 C

steps.component: oven-baked chicken nuggets
steps.text: Cut the chicken into nugget-sized pieces and season with salt

steps.component: oven-baked chicken nuggets
steps.text: Set up flour, beaten egg, and breadcrumbs mixed with paprika and garlic powder in three plates

steps.component: oven-baked chicken nuggets
steps.text: Coat each piece of chicken in flour, egg and breadcrumbs and lay on the lined tray
steps.checkpoint: breaded nuggets are on the tray

steps.component: oven-baked chicken nuggets
steps.text: Drizzle with oil and bake for about 15 to 18 minutes, turning once, until golden
steps.checkpoint: nuggets are golden and cooked through

steps.component: Sichuan spicy fish with glass noodles and potatoes
steps.text: Slice the fish into thin pieces and marinate with salt, wine, egg white and cornstarch

steps.component: Sichuan spicy fish with glass noodles and potatoes
steps.text: Soak the glass noodles in warm water

steps.component: Sichuan spicy fish with glass noodles and potatoes
steps.text: Peel and slice the potatoes thickly

steps.component: Sichuan spicy fish with glass noodles and potatoes
steps.text: Slice the garlic and ginger and cut the spring onions

steps.component: Sichuan spicy fish with glass noodles and potatoes
steps.text: Snip the dried chilies

steps.component: Sichuan spicy fish with glass noodles and potatoes
steps.text: Boil the potatoes until just tender, then the noodles briefly, and put both in the serving bowl
steps.checkpoint: potatoes and noodles line the serving bowl

steps.component: Sichuan spicy fish with glass noodles and potatoes
steps.text: Fry the doubanjiang in oil in the wok until red, then add garlic, ginger and spring onions
steps.checkpoint: red aromatic oil in the wok

steps.component: Sichuan spicy fish with glass noodles and potatoes
steps.text: Add the stock and bring to a boil

steps.component: Sichuan spicy fish with glass noodles and potatoes
steps.text: Slide in the fish pieces one by one and simmer until just opaque

steps.component: Sichuan spicy fish with glass noodles and potatoes
steps.text: Pour the fish and broth over the potatoes and noodles
steps.checkpoint: fish and broth fill the serving bowl

steps.component: Sichuan spicy fish with glass noodles and potatoes
steps.text: Heat oil in the small pan with the dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns until fragrant

steps.component: Sichuan spicy fish with glass noodles and potatoes
steps.text: Pour the sizzling oil over the fish and top with cilantro
steps.checkpoint: fish is topped with chilies and sizzling oil

steps.component: Sichuan spicy fish with glass noodles and potatoes
steps.text: Serve the spicy fish with the chicken nuggets
steps.checkpoint: fish and nuggets are on the table
